pairs.rationale: Sn-Cu plated barrier: Cu2O is not stable at positive-plate potential in H2SO4 (Cu dissolves; Cu contamination poisons Pb cells); Pourbaix cited at cell voltage 2.27 V instead of electrode potential vs SHE; 15-year real-time test with an inconsistent '1000 cycles' measurement clause. Improved over graphene but still infeasible as written.

Nanoclay/EVOH tortuosity is standard nanocomposite literature - novelty DOWN from the discarded UV-crosslink idea; crystallinity 28-32% mislabeled '[user constraint compliance]'; 18-month real-time test, no acceleration model. Feasible, weaker invention.

GBT on 1 Hz SCADA current-variance SPI is measurable and honestly calibrated (post-mortem correlation), but converges on the baseline's power-drift idea - novelty DOWN; replaces the 1.0.0 kurtosis-at-1Hz defect. Feasible, imitative.

QUESTION-TYPE VIOLATION: predictor-design problem answered with a VPI rewind intervention; '3x life extension - user's own stated value' is fabricated; 70% PD reduction -> 6-month lead causal chain asserted, not derived; dubious DOI 10.21063/jtv.2024.2.1.78-84.

Polyurea coating, no replacement, executable accelerated test (750 h D1149, uncoated controls, numeric criterion) - testability improved; BUT 'field trials confirm efficacy' is fabricated evidence, urea/urethane chemistry conflated, 75-year equivalence unmodeled.

Vapor-reflux sealant concept is interesting, but 'osmotic pressure ~100 Pa' driving VAPOR transport is a category error (osmosis acts on liquid solute chemical potential); 'aqueous/organic hybrid' mischaracterizes 2.7 V EDLC chemistry; height budget unquantified; IL-polymer lead discarded.

DEFECT CLASS RECURRENCE: 1-10 kHz spectral power from 1-minute historian samples is Nyquist-impossible (max resolvable ~8 mHz); same thesis DOI reused with new fabricated precision (15-25%); brush material mislabeled user-stated. Infeasible as written.

Condenser DeltaP is NOT in the allowed BMS point list; 'user-approved BMS signals' fabricated; CFI 0.75 arbitrary; validation has no energy-reduction kill criterion and no weather normalization. Infeasible as written.

Scope now compliant (existing 1 A balancer, no footprint), BUT 1 A x 10 ms = 0.0028 mAh, not the claimed 10 mAh (x3600 error); balancing direction confused (hot cells self-discharge faster - they need LESS aggressive balancing, not more); per-cell temperature sensing assumed without hardware basis.

DEFECT CLASS RECURRENCE: 1.5-10 kHz harmonic band from 15-minute averaged load current is impossible; PD producing 0.1% (0.7 A) load-current harmonics is physically absurd; npj Flexible Electronics DOI cited for transformer PD. Infeasible as written.
